# Logo assets

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| claude-symbol.svg | [Wikimedia Commons: Claude AI symbol](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Claude_AI_symbol.svg) | CC0 |
| anthropic-wordmark.svg | [Wikimedia Commons: Anthropic logo](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Anthropic_logo.svg) | Public domain |
| anthropic-wordmark-dark.svg | Recolored copy of the above for dark backgrounds | Public domain |

The shareable images `roadmap.svg` and `social-preview.svg`, and their rendered PNGs, embed the Claude symbol path from the CC0 file above; they are the maintainer's own layout and content.

The artwork files are public domain or CC0 as simple text and geometric marks. The Claude and Anthropic names and marks themselves are trademarks of Anthropic PBC; they are used here only to refer to Anthropic's certification program, which this repository documents. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
